name: pharmacy-os
description: Local-first pharmacy operations platform for Pakistani pharmacies

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/config && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/shared && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/database
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/api && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/worker && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
